en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2783 - Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

I asked him about a man who forgot to perform the visitation of the Kaaba (Tawaf al-Ziyara) until the morning.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that. I myself sometimes delay it until the days of Tashreeq have passed. However, he must not approach women or use perfume."
